the morphology of PA11/clay nanoclay is exfoliated at low clay loading and intercalated at high clay loading, and that the melt rheological properties of the nanocomposites are affected by the morphology.
the morphology and melt rheology properties of PA11 clay nanocomposites have a strong dependence on clay loading.
the melt rheological properties of nylon 11 nanocomposites can be tailored by varying the nanoclay loading, and the complex viscosity is not a good predictor for the steady state viscosity.

the morphology and melt rheology properties of nylon 11 nanocomposites.
the morphology and melt rheology (both linear and nonlinear viscosities) of PA11/clay nanoclay nanocomposites.
the preparation and characterization of clay/polymer nanocomposites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the rheological properties of the nanocomposites are strongly influenced by the clay morphology and the degree of dispersion.
the melt rheology of PA11 nanofillers is a complex function of the clay morphology, the shear rate, and clay loading.
the melt rheology of the PA11/clay nanoclay nanocomposite is strongly influenced by the morphology and the filler content.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the melt rheology of PA11/clay nancomposites is strongly influenced by the morphology of the nanocomposites, which in turn is determined by the clay loading and the melt processing history.
the rheology of PA11/clay nanomaterials can be used as a tool for monitoring their morphology and for predicting their processing behavior.
the morphology of clay nanocomposite depends on the nanofiller content and the shear rate.

the rheological properties of the PA11 nanocomposite are strongly influenced by the morphology, which in turn depends on the nanoclay concentration and processing conditions.
